title: Section 173 BNSS — FIR in cognizable cases

content.overview: Section 173 is the FIR provision. It replaces CrPC 154 and adds Zero FIR and electronic registration.
content.study: If the information discloses a cognizable offence, register. Territorial want of jurisdiction is not a ground to refuse — take a Zero FIR and send it on. A preliminary enquiry, where permitted, is short and dated. Do not cite CrPC 154 as current law except for matters saved by BNSS 531.
